english:
Collecting an Ammo Brick grants Kinetic Weapon Surge for 10 seconds. Special Bricks grant 2 stacks, and Heavy Bricks grant 3 stacks.

Does not overwrite stronger Weapon Surges.

source.text:
On Ammo Brick Pickup:

Grants Kinetic Weapon Surge for 10 seconds.
Special Brick = x2 Kinetic Weapon Surge.
Heavy Brick = x3 Kinetic Weapon Surge.

Does not overwrite stronger Weapon Surges.
